title: java.lang.UnsatisfiedLinkError library "libgodot_android.so" not found
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in production with versions 4.5.2, 4.6-beta1.

### System information

Pixel Pro 6, Android 12

### Issue description

Getting random crash reports from Google Play on various Android devices. Added crashalytics and firebase to capture the crash log. Game is exported with both architectures: armeabi-v7a and arm64-v8a.

Full stacktrace below:
